use_case: Consumer generative AI chatbot (free personal account) used to draft plain-language patient counseling sheets; before 2026-08-07 also used to check compounding calculations and answer drug questions, with patient details pasted in 6 conversations
vendor_or_model: Consumer generative AI chatbot vendor (general-purpose large language model); no BAA available on the free plan
data_categories: As restricted: general drug information with no patient details. As used before 2026-08-07: patient names or initials, ages, drugs, doses, and in 2 conversations allergies (ePHI)
consequential_decision_category: None (restricted use: documentation drafting only). Health care as used before 2026-08-07, because calculation checks fed dispensing decisions
human_in_the_loop: Pharmacist reviews and edits every counseling sheet against the drug reference before any patient receives it; no AI output is used for calculations, doses, or formulations
applicable_laws: HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules (no BAA, so no PHI); HIPAA Breach Notification Rule (164.402 assessment of the 6 conversations); Section 1557 45 CFR 92.4 and 92.210 if ever used to support clinical decisions (not allowed under POL-01 9.5)
status: Approved (restricted use from 2026-09-08; PHI and calculation use retired 2026-08-07)

use_case: PMS drug utilization review (DUR) alerts: rule-based interaction, duplicate therapy, dose range, allergy, age, and pregnancy and lactation screening at prescription entry
vendor_or_model: PMS vendor rules engine with a licensed drug knowledge base (covered by the PMS BAA)
data_categories: Age; sex; pregnancy and lactation flags; allergies; medication history; dose (ePHI)
human_in_the_loop: Pharmacist reviews every alert and decides to fill, change after calling the prescriber, or refuse; the alert never blocks or fills on its own
applicable_laws: 45 CFR 92.210 (a patient care decision support tool under 92.4; inputs include age and sex); HIPAA (PMS BAA)
